title: It just took a little Paciencia y Fe but WE FINALLY GOT THE @New York...
transcript: Yeah, we finally got the cast for New York City center’s In the Heights and I am excited. But I don't think you all realise what my favourite connection that's part of this casting announcement is. I really love that for the most part, they haven't gotten a lot of big household Broadway names, other than, of course, Tony Award winner Natalie Venetia Belcon, who's going to break us with her Paciencia y Fe. But for the most part, these are a lot of performers who have done replacement casts or national tours or I've seen a ton of them at regional theatres across the country, and let me tell you, they're all stars in their own right. And so I love that that's the direction that they've gone in. Because the original cast of In the Heights was not big Broadway names. In the Heights made them big Broadway names. But the coolest connection to me in all of this casting is that Jaci Calderon, who is going to be Nina in this production, was just seen earlier this year in the world premiere of Basura, which is a new musical that premiered at the Alliance Theatre in Atlanta. And do you know who played her mom in that production? Original Nina herself, Mandy Gonzalez. This is just so freaking cool to me and I cannot wait for more of y'all to see her, cause she's incredible, as is this entire cast. I am so excited for this production and this Casting makes me even more excited. In the Heights is going to be at New York City Center from October 28th to November 15th. They just added more $28 access tickets today, so if you haven't gotten your tickets yet and you're looking for an affordable option, get those sooner rather than later because they have already sold out once. Easily one of my most anticipated shows of this fall. I am so excited for this production. I truly think In the Heights is a perfect musical.
classificationReason: Creator reacts to a casting announcement for NYC City Center's In the Heights — this is anticipation/casting news commentary, not a first-hand review of a live production. In the Heights is not on the provided show list, so showId is null.
